🚨 ALERT: Your Medicare plan might be changing on you, and you don't even know it. 👻
Every October, plans quietly change what they cover, what they charge, and which doctors they still like. And every year, folks find out the hard way — usually at the pharmacy counter, usually not smiling.

Medicare Annual Enrollment Period: October 15 – December 7

This is your ONE shot each year to review, switch, or upgrade your Medicare coverage with no penalty, no drama, just paperwork (which, don't worry, we handle for you).

At BlessedBenefitsLLC, we're locally based and owned (Lenoir City, TN), we're licensed, and we're very passionate about helping our neighbors avoid coverage surprises, and helping our neighbors get the best coverage possible. Come get a free plan review before the window closes on December 7 — because "I'll deal with it later" is not a winning strategy. See if you qualify for lower copays and better benefits! You MAY even qualify for a monthly food card allowance, or money back on your Social Security check! 

📞 Call/text us today. Let's make sure your benefits are actually blessing you.

BlessedBenefitsLLC | Lenoir City, TN

items.text: I had my original request for surgery denied.  My physician and I both appealed.  I appealed  for an expedited appeal because I need to come off certain meds prior to surgery.  It is over one week now and still no answer from Aetna.  Aetna sucks.  Wish we could go somewhere else but this is the plan chosen for our retirement benefits through my husband's union.

topComments.text: You do not have to stay with the union’s plan. It is not mandatory.
We dumped them last enrollment. How can they override the doctor.

items.text: I have had my issues with Aetna--but my husband was taken to a non network hospital and of course I was thinking that is going to be a problem--so I messaged Aetna and they said because it was an emergency they treat it as if it's in network--and he had reached his spending limit so there has been no charges so far--fingers crossed it stays that way--

topComments.text: Glad to hear that and I hope he feels better. What state are you in, because I hear things differ state to state. I am in Florida.
Yea my plan my elequis is 424.00 a month, but someone trying to loose weight is paying 100.00 or less  quess my stroke doesn’t mean anything.
